name: Leon
source:
The leader of the fluff army. He patrols Fluffgrass Plains to keep the Cemetery fluffs away from Mainland. Legends say he's the only fluff who rose to nobility despite being raised a commoner, but his personality is unfit for his position. He's easygoing and curious, loves the world of humans, and has met many other humans in the past. 

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fluffness/fluffland]Kickstarter[/url]]
